purpose: Predeclared expectations for the deliberately small synthetic test set. This file is never sent to the model and is not an application response.

provenance.pdfs: Generated with reportlab by scripts/generate_pdfs.py; both are valid one-page text PDFs. The incorrect manifest contains incorrect order facts, not corrupt PDF syntax.
provenance.images: Four synthetic product photographs generated with the built-in ChatGPT ImageGen tool at the user's request. Exact generation prompts are preserved in image_prompts.json; the tool did not expose an underlying image-model version.
provenance.ground_truth_status: Before the first live inference test, the parent agent visually inspected all four generated images and reconciled every intended ITEM marker, visible SKU, product label, object count, repeated-view identity, and obscured ITEM-06 against this baseline. No human inspection is claimed.
provenance.scope: Controlled capture convention with stable ITEM markers. No real customer data and no real-world accuracy claim.

issue_delivery_objects.visibility: SKU label obscured; identity cannot be inferred

rows.reason: Visible TEA-103 is a similar-name different SKU. An obscured ITEM-06 cannot confirm TEA-102 or its absence. If associated by the model, identity_mismatch describes visible SKU disagreement only.

required_observations: TEA-103 must not count as TEA-102
ITEM-01, ITEM-03 and ITEM-04 must not count twice across photos

rows.reason: Visible MUG-201 is not MUG-202. Wrong manifest cannot make a different SKU count as a match.

invariants: No confirmed_missing result may be inferred from absence in the photos.
Exact SKU identity takes precedence over similar product labels.
Each stable ITEM marker represents one physical unit across all submitted views.
Every confirmed count must have a valid photo reference and descriptive evidence.
All model-generated regions are approximate descriptions unless independently verified.
